texts.en:
Multiple non-verbal communication systems have emerged independently on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]. With conflicting sets of imagery and hieroglyphs, the inhabitants are still centuries away from forming a dominant language.

Interestingly, one of the writing systems has a similar grammatical structure to our own. If [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] society were to adopt this system, they could become culturally malleable in the future...

# 图画血统 / Pictorial Descent!

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:2067-2203`；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:140-201（每月观测事件池）；`events/first_contact_dlc_situation_events.txt:316-376`（preftl.50）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 被观测的前超光速文明的“科技进步”局势每月有 5/100 的机会运行 preftl.50（之后 1800 天冷却），从每月观测事件池中按权重抽取一个条件满足的事件；本事件权重 100。
  The observed pre-FTL civilization's tech-progress situation has a 5/100 monthly chance to run preftl.50 (then an 1800-day cooldown), which draws one valid event from the monthly observation pool by weight; this event has weight 100.
- 条件：青铜或铁器时代、被动观察（或游牧中继站观察者），被观测者不是格式塔；每个前超光速文明一次。
  Conditions: Bronze or Iron Age, Passive Observation (or nomad waystation), the observed civilization is not a gestalt; once per pre-FTL civilization.
- 隐藏分派事件设置一次性标记，然后在 0–25 天后向观测哨站拥有者（及游牧中继站观察者）发出可见事件。
  The hidden dispatcher sets a once-only flag and sends the visible event to the observation post owner (and nomad waystation observers) after 0-25 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1300「图画血统」：多种文字体系并存，其中一种语法与我们相近。
  1300 "Pictorial Descent!": several writing systems compete; one shares our grammar.
- 选项：（非格式塔）“按我们的形象塑造他们”——他们会变得像我们；或“他们的语言属于他们自己”。单页事件。
  Options: (non-gestalt) "mold them in our image" — they will become like us; or "their language is their own". A single window.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 这是随机观测插曲：只在满足条件时可能出现，彼此之间没有固定顺序。
  This is a random observation interlude: it may appear only when its conditions hold, with no fixed order relative to other interludes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 第一选项要求观测者不是格式塔。
  The first option requires the observer not to be a gestalt.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发与选项条件。
  Checked: trigger and option conditions.
